headline: 5 core protocol contracts catalogued on Stellar mainnet; factory pattern allows permissionless pool creation

findings.text: Stellar network uses Stellar Expert explorer (not Etherscan-style). Deployments page references contracts by Stellar Expert URLs.
Official deployments page located at docs.blend.capital/mainnet-deployments lists 5 core Blend V2 contracts and 1 adjacent contract (Comet) on Stellar mainnet.
Code4rena audit conducted Feb 24 - Mar 17, 2025; GitHub repo indicates audits folder exists but fetch was blocked. Audit reports referenced in FAQs.
GitHub repository blend-capital/blend-contracts-v2 identified; audits subdirectory present but not fetchable this run.
Protocol is on single chain (Stellar); no multi-chain enumeration required.

Pool Factory contract (CDSYOAVXFY7SM5S64IZPPPYB4GVGGLMQVFREPSQQEZVIWXX5R23G4QSU) exists; permissionless pool creation means child enumeration would be unbounded. DeFiLlama reports 3 pools tracked on Blend Pools V2 but specific pool addresses not yet discovered.

Contracts classified by function: token (BLND), emitter (emission logic), backstop (reserve fund), factory (pool deployment), comet (liquidity pool). No explicit admin/multisig addresses discovered on this run.
All addresses traced to fetched official deployments page.

rationale.verdict: Discovered 5 core protocol contracts on Stellar mainnet from official deployments documentation. Factory pattern suggests permissionless pool creation; individual pool addresses would require RPC enumeration. Audit reports exist but detailed scope not yet retrieved.

evidence.shows: Official list of Blend V2 mainnet smart contract addresses on Stellar: BLND Token (CD25MNVTZDL4Y3XBCPCJXGXATV5WUHHOWMYFF4YBEGU5FCPGMYTVG5JY), Emitter (CCOQM6S7ICIUWA225O5PSJWUBEMXGFSSW2PQFO6FP4DQEKMS5DASRGRR), Backstop (CAQQR5SWBXKIGZKPBZDH3KM5GQ5GUTPKB7JAFCINLZBC5WXPJKRG3IM7), Pool Factory (CDSYOAVXFY7SM5S64IZPPPYB4GVGGLMQVFREPSQQEZVIWXX5R23G4QSU), Comet (CAS3FL6TLZKDGGSISDBWGGPXT3NRR4DYTZD7YOD3HMYO6LTJUVGRVEAM).
Official website confirms Blend is a universal liquidity protocol primitive for permissionless lending pool creation; links to docs, GitHub repos, and Discord community.
Public Soroban implementation repo for Blend Protocol V2; contains audits folder, backstop, emitter, pool-factory, and pool contract implementations; Rust codebase with test suites.
FAQs reference that Blend Protocol has been audited by third parties; audit reports linked but specific URLs not resolved this run.
Code4rena conducted Blend V2 audit plus Certora formal verification from Feb 24 - Mar 17, 2025 ($125k prize pool).
DeFiLlama tracks Blend Pools V2 with $96.01m TVL on Stellar; 3 pools tracked; Feb 22, 2026 price oracle manipulation incident documented.

protocol_metadata.about: Blend is a modular liquidity protocol primitive built on Stellar's Soroban smart contract engine. It enables permissionless creation of isolated lending pools where users can deposit assets to earn interest or use collateral to borrow. Each pool is independent with its own backstop fund serving as an emergency reserve; pool creators can customize supported assets, collateral requirements, and oracle selection.
